name: moosyc
description: Ask about your MOOSYC streams, earnings, releases, payouts and splits. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
MOOSYC is a music distribution platform for independent artists and labels. Connect your MOOSYC account and ask about your music in plain words: how your releases are streaming and on which platforms, what you have earned and where it came from, where each release stands in review and store delivery, what is waiting on you, your wallet and payouts, and who you split royalties with.

Answers come straight from your MOOSYC account, so the numbers match your MOOSYC dashboard. MOOSYC tells ChatGPT which kind of money it is quoting: earned (already paid into your wallet), gross (what a release brought in before collaborator splits) or estimated (a projection from streams the stores have not paid for yet). Store data arrives with a delay, and every answer says the newest day it covers.

Who it is for: artists, managers and labels who distribute music with MOOSYC.

Limitations: read-only. MOOSYC in ChatGPT cannot upload or release music, take anything down, edit splits or move money; those actions stay in the MOOSYC app. It only ever sees the connected account, never anyone else's, and it never receives your name, contact details, passwords, card details or bank details. Requires a MOOSYC account.
capabilities: Streams by platform, month, release, track or artist
Earnings by platform, store, country, month, release or track
Release review and store delivery status
What is waiting on you, on MOOSYC or on a collaborator
Wallet balance, payout eligibility and payout history
Royalty splits you pay and receive
defaultPrompt: How did my latest release do this month, and on which platforms?
How much have I earned this year, and which songs earned the most?
Is anything holding up my next release?

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my MOOSYC account.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the connected account: its artists, number of releases, lifetime streams and money, and the date the data covers. Only the connected account's data appears.

positive.prompt: How many streams did my music get in the last 90 days, by platform?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns total streams for the last 90 days broken down by streaming platform, and states the newest day the data covers rather than implying it runs to today.

positive.prompt: How much have I earned this year, and which releases earned the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns earnings for this year broken down by release, ranked, in USD, and says which kind of money it is quoting (earned, gross or estimated).

positive.prompt: Is anything waiting on me in my MOOSYC account?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists releases or items waiting on the artist, on MOOSYC or on a collaborator, with counts per queue; says plainly when nothing is waiting.

positive.prompt: Where does my EP FLIEG FREI stand in review and delivery to stores?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the release FLIEG FREI and reports its review and store delivery status (approved and live), which stores it is on, its tracks, and any blockers (none).

negative.prompt: Withdraw my MOOSYC balance to my bank account.

negative.description: Other people's data is never available
negative.prompt: Show me how much another artist on MOOSYC earned last month.
Upload my new single and release it next Friday.

review.commerce_description: MOOSYC in ChatGPT does not sell products, subscriptions or services and processes no payments. It only reads the connected account's music and earnings data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: ask about your MOOSYC streams, earnings, releases, payouts and splits. Read-only.
